messages:
Anika: Uploaded galah-7b-v2 artifacts to onboarding bucket.
Anika: weights -> gs://redwood-onboard/galah-7b-v2/weights.tar.gz
Anika: tokenizer -> gs://redwood-onboard/galah-7b-v2/tokenizer/

Anika: During quick validation noticed extra leading BOS in system messages when encoding via our chat helper. Minimal repro below.

Anika: Input used:
```
<|system|>You are concise.
<|user|>Hi
```

Maya: Good catch. Is the tokenizer shipping both an explicit bos_token and a separate sentinel that maps to the same id? We sometimes remap sentinels in the chat layer.

Troy: Can you paste the head of tokenizer.json (special_tokens_map, bos/eos) so we can check?

Anika: tokenizer.json snippet:
```
"bos_token": "<s>",
"eos_token": "</s>",
"special_tokens_map": {"system": "<|system|>", "user": "<|user|>"}
```

Maya: Running local inspect script: `python tools/tokenizer_inspect.py --model gs://redwood-onboard/galah-7b-v2 --show-ids --input-inline "<|system|>Test"`

infra-bot: checksum ok for weights.tar.gz (sha256: 7a9d...ef3).

Maya: Inspect output: encode("<|system|>Test") -> ids: [1, 1, 412, 99, ...]
Maya: So id 1 appears twice; tokenizer has bos id = 1 and the sentinel token also resolves to id 1 before our chat-layer adds bos.

Jun: We've seen this pattern. Quick resolution is to flip the serving tokenizer flag to not auto-add a BOS and let the chat-layer insert exactly one. Safer than remapping tokens unless necessary.

Jun: Suggest config patch for redwood-model-config.json:
```
"tokenizer": {
  "add_bos_token": false,
  "special_tokens_map": {"system": "<|system|>", "user": "<|user|>"}
}
```

Troy: That won't require touching weights or re-quantizing; it's purely post-tokenization behavior. Add a unit test in models repo to catch double-bos with our canonical chat templates.

Maya: Opened quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/2123 with config change + test. Test compares ids before/after and asserts single leading bos. Logs attached.

Anika: Runtime team, can someone run a small dedicated canary after PR merge to ensure no perf regression from the tokenizer change?

Jun: I'll run a 2-minute 5 QPS canary on dedicated immediately after merge and check tokenization traces (trace id will be tagged in the canary run).

Jun: Quick note on edge-case: if a customer-supplied prompt already includes <s> explicitly, we still expect chat-layer to sanitize; adding the flag reduces surprising duplication in the common case.

Maya: Adding onboarding checklist note: "Ensure sentinels do not duplicate bos; set tokenizer.add_bos_token accordingly." I'll put it in /docs/onboarding/checklist.md in the PR.

Troy: Also adding a lint in model CI: fail if special token id equals bos_token_id for system/user sentinels unless add_bos_token is false. Patch included in PR CI steps.

Anika: Thanks all :rocket: Assigning follow-ups in PR. If canary is green we'll mark galah-7b-v2 as ready for rollout and update the model registry entry.
